title: Publish recovery inventory adapter composition surface
description: Objective: make the four landed node-side recovery inventory registrations legally consumable by the daemon without deep imports or mutable global registration. Deliverable: a curated @moe/runner root surface that exports providerLockInventoryRegistration, workspaceInventoryRegistration, gitIntegrationInventoryRegistration, artifactObjectInventoryRegistration and the exact input/port/refusal type closure needed to construct them, while preserving caller-injected immutable registry composition. MEASURED GAP at HEAD c0c5929: packages/runner/package.json exports only '.', packages/runner/src/index.ts exports the contract and collect/create registry but none of the four factories, and a bare @moe/runner runtime probe returns undefined for all four while deep import fails ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED. Consumer: task-cf7fb147bd1c47698cbd65c9535370aa. NOT in scope: daemon ports, enumeration behavior changes, new inventory classes, quarantine, persistence, embargo, or recovery.complete. Owned paths: packages/runner/src/surface/recovery-inventory-surface.ts (+ mandatory .js bridge), minimal packages/runner/src/index.ts wiring, and the focused root/runtime surface test. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test.
definitionOfDone: The @moe/runner package root exports all four existing registration factories and the exact public input/port/refusal type closure required by an external daemon consumer; no deep import or package exports-map change is needed.

The surface delegates to the landed adapter modules unchanged and keeps createRecoveryInventoryRegistry caller-injected; no mutable module-global registry, fallback enumerator, or duplicate inventory implementation is introduced.

A compiled/bare-specifier runtime test imports @moe/runner, constructs each registration through the published factory, asserts the four exact class identities and a non-zero count of four, and pins any refusal code/layer produced by the real aggregate.

Existing recovery-inventory and root namespace tests remain green, every new .ts module has the exact LF .js bridge required by NodeNext, and production sources remain below the per-file 400-line cap.
Fresh pnpm --filter @moe/runner typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/runner test exits 0.
taskRails: Publish existing authority only; do not change the four adapters, their class vocabulary, the aggregate, or any refusal code.
Keep registration immutable and caller-injected. A module-global registry would make import order authority and is forbidden.
Tests must drive the package root, assert exact class/cardinality and exact stable reason code/layer; symbol presence alone is not composition.
Target <=250 physical lines per production source and split before 400; the cap is per file.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Rejected (1) adding four inline exports to packages/runner/src/index.ts because that production entry point is already 275 lines and the repository targets <=250; (2) blanket export * from the adapter modules because it would leak enumerate* functions and version constants outside the four-factory contract; (3) changing package.json exports/deep-import paths because the durable consumer must use the reviewed package root; and (4) a module-global/default registry because import order must never confer inventory authority. Chosen approach: extract the existing inventory root block into one explicit curated surface, publish only the four landed factories plus their type-only construction/refusal closure, and keep registry composition caller-injected.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: Re-measured at HEAD 2b15b8f01ee0b4a52deb6bb78e510e0ca60d9c66. Command `pnpm --filter @moe/runner exec node --experimental-strip-types --input-type=module -e <bare import probe>` returned all four requested bindings as `undefined` (count 0); a direct `@moe/runner/recovery-inventory/provider-lock-inventory.js` import returned `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`. The landed factories exist at provider-lock-inventory.ts:240, workspace-inventory.ts:242, git-integration-inventory.ts:242, and artifact-object-inventory.ts:186 and each returns a frozen RecoveryInventoryRegistration over injected ports. createRecoveryInventoryRegistry at recovery-inventory.ts:53 snapshots/freezes the caller tuple, and duplicate registrations are refused by collectRecoveryInventory as `RECOVERY_INVENTORY_REQUEST_INVALID` / `INVENTORY_ADAPTER`. packages/runner/src/index.ts:207-251 currently owns the explicit aggregate/contract exports; move that block to the new surface then re-export the surface so the root shrinks below 250 without changing existing names. Existing runtime-entrypoint.test.ts dynamically walks every runtime module and requires the exact LF bridge bytes, while index-surface.test.ts hand-pins the complete root namespace. Do not touch the four adapter files (248/250/250/194 lines), the 378-line aggregate, class vocabulary, codes/layers, or adapter behavior. Add exactly four runtime root values; direct enumerators and *_INVENTORY_VERSION constants remain private. Git/artifact factories intentionally expose aggregate UNKNOWN coverage rather than their direct enumerator refusal side-channel; do not change that protocol here. Tests must assert generated count exactly/nonzero four and exact code/layer, and the worker must mutation-drill the production root comparison/export rather than a helper. Preserve foreign scheduler work visible in the shared tree; commit only these owned runner paths.
